notes: Quick Stack & Sort: /realm:sort and Sort my inventory now sort every inventory page together: like stacks merge across pages and the sorted stacks fill page 1 first, then page 2 and on. /realm:inv adds Sort all pages; Sort this page still sorts only the page you see.
Minimap: champions show as a red dot in a bright orange ring on the compass strip and radar, within 128 blocks and at the edges when out of sight.
Choir sieges: the Choir Singer has a red name and shows on the Minimap like a champion, so a Singer that wandered off is easy to find.

Minimap: uses about half the server time it did; with many players moving the radar's land and mob dots catch up a few seconds later. Operators can pick High in /realm:config -> Minimap for the earlier behavior.
Silly Enchants costs less on a busy server: its every-tick checks run only while someone wears Hyper Jump boots.
Expedition dungeons build in shorter steps, so a busy server no longer hitches while one is built.
Champions cost less at night: their aura and approach read less from the game.
Champions: a player who leaves the game with the Champions menu open no longer leaves an error in the server log.
Town Projects: removing a build puts back only the town's own blocks, so your blocks there stay even when they are the same kind (cobblestone by a well, dirt on its ground).
Town Projects: a removed town's villagers move away instead of staying behind, and a garden pen never ends up with extra animals.
Town Projects: a new town build no longer walls in a villager, pet or animal standing on its spot; they are moved aside first.
resourceNotes: Side HUD: new Minimap icons for champions and Choir Singers (a red dot in a bright orange ring, and its edge arrows).
Easy Building's resources: line endings tidied (no change for players).

map_bp.notes: Champions and Choir Singers show as a red dot in a bright orange ring within 128 blocks (strip, its edges and the radar, at the edge when beyond it). One shared tag search per dimension every 10 ticks; they are left out of the ordinary mob search.

town_bp.notes: Remove spot never touches your blocks, even of a kind the build uses; builds move mobs and dropped items aside instead of walling them in; a removed town's residents move away (what they carry drops); the garden pen keeps exactly its 2 sheep and 2 chickens; spot picking does less work per spot.

npc_bp.notes: Town mayors: each town can have its own mayor who takes deliveries for that town; mayors share town news.

welcome_bp.notes: The welcome page lists Town Projects: towns that grow as you help, each with its mayor.

admin_bp.notes: The Realm Configuration menu shows /realm:sort's new description: it sorts every inventory page together.

silly_bp.notes: Cheaper on busy servers: nothing runs every tick unless someone wears Hyper Jump boots or is mid-flight.

expedition_bp.notes: Dungeon builds and resets spread their work over more, shorter steps: no build step holds a server tick for long.

elite_bp.notes: A player who leaves with the Champions menu open no longer leaves an error in the server log.

stash_bp.notes: Sorting your inventory (/realm:sort, Sort my inventory, and the new Sort all pages in /realm:inv) sorts every page as one: like stacks merge across pages, then stacks are ordered by item and refill page 1, page 2 and on. Slot-locked stacks and the buttons stay; all pages commit together or nothing changes.

calendar_bp.notes: The Choir Singer has a red name and the realm:siege_singer tag, so the Minimap draws it like a champion.

hud_rp.notes: Four new Minimap glyphs: the champion's ringed dot on the strip and radar and its left and right edge arrows.
